dashboard_item.raw_yaml:
title: Detect Suspicious cmd.exe Spawning whoami.exe
id: 323aa38f-f5d1-4c89-a672-c37cc982a12a
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious execution of whoami.exe spawned by cmd.exe, which
  is a common technique for information gathering.
references: https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1087/
author: SigmaGen
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.t1087
- attack.t1059.003
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: \whoami.exe
    ParentImage|endswith: \cmd.exe
    CommandLine|contains: whoami  /all
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administrative script execution
level: medium
dashboard_item.wazuh_xml:
<group name="ml_generated,sysmon,">
  <rule id="100153" level="8">
    <if_group>sysmon_event1</if_group>
    <field name="win.eventdata.image" type="pcre2">(?i)\\+whoami\.exe$</field>
    <field name="win.eventdata.parentImage" type="pcre2">(?i)\\+cmd\.exe$</field>
    <field name="win.eventdata.commandLine" type="pcre2">(?i)whoami\ \ /all</field>
    <description>Detect Suspicious cmd.exe Spawning whoami.exe [Alert: AI-20261012_133246.047-940982ec4fa0]</description>
    <mitre>
      <id>T1087</id>
      <id>T1059.003</id>
    </mitre>
  </rule>
</group>
